title: Understanding User Status - VPN Service Edge Log Fields

blocks.text: The Log Streaming Service (LSS) can send User Status - VPN Service Edge log information to any third-party log analytics tool. By default, the User Status - VPN Service Edge log type includes the fields listed in the following table for each log template (i.e., CSV, JSON, TSV). While configuring your log receiver, you can edit the default log stream content to capture only specific fields, and create a custom log template.

You can use the shared ConnectionID key field to merge user status logs produced by both VPN Service Edge and VPN Service Edge (IP Address Reservation). This common identifier enables SIEM servers to effectively link, correlate, and integrate the data from both sources.

blocks.item: View a User Status - VPN Service Edge log example.

blocks.text: The following table includes descriptions and supported field format specifications for each field within the template. To learn more about the format specifications listed for each field, including examples, see Understanding the Log Stream Content Format.

table: The timestamp when the log was generated
The status of the VPN connection: Connecting Connected Disconnected
The name of the device reported by Zscaler Client Connector. This field only provides valid values for Zscaler Client Connector and machine tunnel client types.
The unique identifier for the user connection
The VPN Service Edge used for the traffic
The Common Name component of the SSL/TLS certificate for identifying the primary identity
The port number for the client
The total bytes of data received during the session
The total bytes of data sent during the session
